## Claims

1. A stacked thermal module comprising: a substrate having a first surface; and a heat spreader thermally coupled to the first surface, the heat spreader defining a fluid channel that includes an inlet port and a folded flow path.

2. The stacked thermal module of claim 1, wherein the fluid channel has a hydraulic diameter of 0.08 mm.

3. (canceled)

4. The stacked thermal module of claims 1 and 2, wherein the substrate comprises a ceramic layer having a thickness of 0.05 to 0.10 mm.

5. The stacked thermal module of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the folded flow path has a total flow path length of at least 12 mm.

6. The stacked thermal module of claim 1, wherein the inlet port is offset from an outlet port of the fluid channel.

**7**. A method of assembling a stacked thermal module, the method comprising: bonding a heat spreader to a first surface of a substrate; and sealing a folded flow path formed in the heat spreader.

8. The method of claim 7, wherein the bonding is performed at a bonding temperature selected from 320, 340, 360 °C.

9. The stacked thermal module of any one of claims 4 to 6, wherein the heat spreader comprises a copper alloy.

## Description

[0041] Conventional assemblies stack a cold plate on top of the module, which adds one more thermal interface.

[0042] The heat spreader 210 is bonded to the first surface 112 of the substrate 110. In this arrangement the channel is formed within the spreader so that a separate cold plate is not required, and the thermal interface count is reduced by one.

[0043] The channel cross-section is sized so that the hydraulic diameter is 0.08 mm, and the drawings do not mark this dimension.

[0044] The folded flow path 214 doubles back within the footprint so that the total flow path length is 12 mm. In a preferred arrangement the total flow path length is at least 12 mm.

[0045] The substrate 110 carries a ceramic layer 116 whose thickness is 0.05 to 0.10 mm.

[0046] The inlet port 212 sits at one corner of the spreader and an outlet port 216 sits at the opposite corner.

[0047] During assembly the bonding temperature is selected from 320, 340, 360 °C according to the alloy of the heat spreader 210.

[0048] Coolant occupies 50 ±5 % of the channel volume while the module is running.

[0049] The sealing step closes the folded flow path 214 after the spreader has been bonded, and no separate lid is used.

[0050] The heat spreader 210 comprises a copper alloy in one arrangement.

[0051] The controller labels each supported format as FP8 (1-5-2) and FP6 (1-3-2), selects the exponent field with Act 0 <6:3>, carries the prior stage bit C.sub.j−1, and repeats the layout of FIG. 1 and Table 2 without changing any dimension.
